soak_evidence.blocking_finding: EMPTY_CHANNEL is STRUCTURAL, not a sample-size problem. All 3 veto-shaped judgments fired 13:23-13:56 ET; the OR-break entry window is 10:00-11:00 ET. Across the entire soak, ZERO judgments have landed in the entry window (records per ET hour: 8:1, 9:1, then nothing until 12:00). The veto cannot bite an entry decision the operator was asleep for. At current coverage this mechanism stays untestable indefinitely — more soak days add nothing.
soak_evidence.unblock_condition: tick coverage during 09:30-11:00 ET. Root cause is host sleep (pmset wake 07:55 fires, but caffeinate -s holds only on AC power with the lid open). Until then MECH-006 accrues no evidence.
